# Lead Magnet & Free Tool Design

`lead-magnet-and-free-tool-design` · v1.0.0 · Design · Conversion & Web
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/lead-magnet-and-free-tool-design/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which lead magnet or free tool should we build first, and is a live one bringing in buyers or just emails?

**Inputs:** Candidate ideas with the buyer problem each solves, its kind (tool, template, assessment, checklist, guide, report, course), minutes to a useful answer, whether it is reusable, whether it appeals only to your buyer, whether its inputs reveal fit, the next step it leads to, whether it is gated, and hours to build; for live magnets, visitors, starts, completions, emails, qualified leads, meetings and cost

**Output:** Each idea scored out of ten with the reasons, ranked by score per ten build hours, with every gated piece of ideas and every missing next step flagged and one idea to build first; for live magnets the funnel from visitor to qualified lead, cost per qualified lead, and a keep, fix-cost, fix-fit, retire or too-early verdict

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill lead-magnet-and-free-tool-design`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/lead-magnet-and-free-tool-design/resources/lead-magnet-fit.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/lead-magnet-and-free-tool-design/resources/lead-magnet-fit.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Idea scores rest on your own answers (appeals only to your buyer, reusable, inputs reveal fit) and your hours estimate. It can't check them or predict whether anyone will use it.
- The ten-point scoring, the 80-hour build flag and the verdict cut-offs (40% and 20% fit, 20 emails minimum) are AAJ's rules, not industry benchmarks.
- The live readout is only as good as your count of qualified leads. A loose ICP match makes a weak magnet look like a keeper.
- Ranking by score per ten build hours favours small builds, so a cheap one-off can outrank a stronger tool. Read the score and the hours together.

**Review before acting:** The marketing lead checks the build estimates include promotion and the follow-up email. The sales lead confirms which emails count as qualified against the ICP before the readout keeps, fixes or retires a magnet.
